# Every mutating /api/v1 route (RENT-BE-001 §8b). The integration suite fails
# when a route below commits without exactly one audit event, or when a
# mutating route of internal/httpapi is missing from this list.
PUT /me
POST /assets
PUT /assets/{id}
POST /tenants
PUT /tenants/{id}
POST /leases
PUT /leases/{id}
POST /leases/{id}/transitions
POST /leases/{id}/guarantees
PUT /guarantees/{id}
PUT /params/{key}
